s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute onset of skin and muscle symptoms following immunotherapy
salient_findings: Prominent erythema at nailfolds with dilated capillary loops
key_facts: Patient is a woman in her 50s
Stage IV B-RAF V600E mutant malignant melanoma with metastases
Developed skin symptoms within 2 weeks of starting ipilimumab treatment
Received a second course of ipilimumab 14 months later
Physical findings include photodistributed erythematous to violaceous eruption
Diffuse erythema of forehead and midface
Erythema and edema of upper eyelids
Creatine kinase level increased to 1854 U/L
Aldolase level was 23.0 U/L
C-reactive protein level was 28.6 mg/L
Antinuclear antibody titer was 1:640 with speckled pattern
Jo-1 antibody was negative
MRI showed mild short TI inversion recovery hyperintensity of bilateral vastus lateralis and rectus femoris muscles
Vastus lateralis muscle biopsy showed atrophy of type II muscle fibers

shortlist.label: Dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient developed skin symptoms and muscle weakness after ipilimumab treatment, with elevated creatine kinase and aldolase levels, and antinuclear antibody titer of 1:640

shortlist.label: Ipilimumab-induced myositis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient received ipilimumab treatment and developed muscle symptoms, with biopsy showing atrophy of type II muscle fibers

shortlist.label: Paraneoplastic dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has stage IV malignant melanoma and developed skin and muscle symptoms, with elevated antinuclear antibody titer and characteristic skin findings

shortlist.label: Necrotizing autoimmune myopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has elevated creatine kinase level and muscle weakness, with biopsy showing atrophy of type II muscle fibers and no evidence of inflammatory myositis

shortlist.label: Melanoma-associated dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has stage IV malignant melanoma and developed skin and muscle symptoms, with characteristic skin findings and elevated antinuclear antibody titer

raw.rationale: The patient's skin symptoms and muscle weakness are consistent with dermatomyositis, and the presence of stage IV B-RAF V600E mutant malignant melanoma suggests a paraneoplastic syndrome.

rejected.label: Dermatomyositis
rejected.why: While the patient's symptoms are consistent with dermatomyositis, the presence of underlying melanoma suggests a paraneoplastic component.

rejected.label: Ipilimumab-induced myositis
rejected.why: The patient's muscle biopsy did not show evidence of inflammatory myositis, and the symptoms persisted after ipilimumab treatment was stopped.

rejected.label: Necrotizing autoimmune myopathy
rejected.why: The patient's muscle biopsy showed atrophy of type II muscle fibers without evidence of necrosis or inflammation.

rejected.label: Melanoma-associated dermatomyositis
rejected.why: This is not a distinct clinical entity, and paraneoplastic dermatomyositis is a more specific and accurate diagnosis.
